name: Liliana, Death Wielder
oracle_text:
+2: Put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature.
−3: Destroy target creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.
−10: Return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
blocked_sentences: −3: Destroy target creature with a -1/-1 counter on it.

needs.what: a selector/target filter key matching a permanent with at least one counter of a NAMED kind (e.g. {"has_counter": "-1/-1"}), so a target spec can say "target creature with a -1/-1 counter on it" and the targeting legality is checked on selection and on resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `has_counters` is a boolean over any kind of counter (selectors.py reads any(n > 0 for n in obj.counters.values())), so it would allow targeting a creature with only +1/+1 or stun counters; `modified` is broader still; `counters_on`/`counters_had` are values usable only in an `if` at resolution, which would change what may be targeted rather than what the printed target restriction allows
